primary.title: SEBI launches Demat 2.0: Key FAQs on the pilot project for tokenised corporate bonds answered
primary.summary: SEBI’s Demat 2.0 pilot will test tokenised corporate bonds using DLT, with the same investor rights as conventional bonds. Here’s how issuance, settlement and CBDC payments will work, why the pilot matters, and when retail investors could participate.
